deities: Goddess Lalita Devi (Adi Shakti; the Shakti Peetha where Sati's heart is said to have fallen)

history.period: Ancient (no published founding date); the present structure is a later construction/renovation (verify)
history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: the Lalita Devi Temple at Naimisharanya is counted among the 51 Shakti Peethas - tradition holds that Sati's heart fell here, making it one of the most spiritually potent energy centres of the Shaktism tradition. The goddess is worshipped as Lalita Devi, a fierce yet compassionate form of Adi Shakti, and the site is an important centre for Tantric practice, especially during Navratri. The complex includes the main sanctum (garbha griha) with the idol of Maa Lalita Devi adorned with flowers, sindoor and silver ornaments, nearby Shivling and Ganesha shrines, a yajna kund with an eternal flame (akhand jyoti), and a pushkarni for ritual baths. It stands a short distance from the Chakratirtha pilgrimage site and can be combined with Vyas Gaddi, Hanuman Garhi and Sita Kund for a full Naimisharanya darshan. Note: a separate, also-famous Lalita Devi Shakti Peetha exists at Prayagraj (Meerapur) - this file documents the Naimisharanya one. Coordinates are for the town of Naimisharanya (the temple is within the town) - verify exact temple coordinates.

name: Lalita Devi Temple
town_description: Naimisharanya, in Sitapur district about 120 km from Lucknow, is an ancient sacred forest-town of Hindu tradition - the legendary site where the Suta narrated the Puranas to the rishis, and the seat of 88,000 sages per myth. It is a major Vaishnava-Shaiva-Shakta pilgrimage circuit centred on the Chakra Tirth tank, the Lalita Devi Shakti Peetha, Vyas Gaddi, Hanuman Garhi and Sita Kund.

travel.airport: Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport, Lucknow - about 120 km (per travel source)
travel.railway: Sitapur Junction is the nearest major station (about 90 km - per travel source); then local transport or cab to Naimisharanya
travel.road: About 120 km from Lucknow and 90 km from Sitapur; regular buses and private cabs available

visitor_information.best_time: Chaitra and Sharadiya Navratri (March-April & September-October), Guru Purnima, Kartik Purnima, Magh month; winters (October-March) are pleasant
